name: Naga, Berserker
body:
NAGA, BERSERKER
CR 8

XP 4,800
CE Huge aberration

Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +18; Aura frightful presence (60 ft., DC 18)

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 8, flat-footed 19 (+2 Dex, +13 natural, –2 rage, –2 size)
hp 137 (11d8+88)
Fort +11 Ref +5, Will +11

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft.
Melee bite +17 (3d6+16)
Space 15 ft.; Reach 15 ft.
Special Attacks arcane combatant, bloodrage (22 rounds/day)
Spells Known (CL 7th; concentration +12)

2nd (2/day)—acid arrow (DC 15), burning gaze (DC 15)
1st (2/day)—burning hands (DC 14), mage armor, true strike, warding weapon

TACTICS

When not raging, the berserker naga’s statistics are AC 23, touch 10, flat-footed 21; hp 115; Melee bite +15 (3d6+13), Str 29, Con 23; CMB +19, CMD 31 (cannot be tripped); Climb +20

STATISTICS

Str 33, Dex 15, Con 27, Int 16, Wis 18, Cha 17
Base Atk +8; CMB +21; CMD 33 (cannot be tripped)
Feats Combat Reflexes, Eschew Materials, Furious Focus, Improved Critical (bite), Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Vital Strike
Skills Acrobatics +14, Climb +22, Intimidate +18, Knowledge (arcana) +15, Knowledge (history) +18, Perception +19, Survival +19
Languages Aklo, Celestial, Common, Draconic, Infernal
SQ change shape (beast shape III)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Arcane Combatant (Ex)

While bloodraging, a berserker naga may cast a bloodrager spell it knows as a free action whenever it confirms a critical hit. In addition, a berserker naga may cast any spell it knows as if it were affected by the still spell metamagic feat.

Bloodrage (Ex)

A berserker naga can bloodrage as a 7th-level bloodrager and may cast bloodrager spells while bloodraging. The berserker naga in the statblock presented above is raging.

Spell Casting

A berserker naga casts spells as a 7th-level bloodrager.

ABOUT

Scaled peoples who give themselves over to bloodlust and conquest reincarnate into forms which suit their battle frenzy: the swift and unrelenting coils of a berserker naga.

Armed with tremendous jaws and imposing size, a berserker naga’s magic burns brightest in the heat of conflict as the creature relishes in each successful blow.
